hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token factory hook that deploys new ERC20 tokens on bonding curve Uniswap v4 pools. Blocks external pool initialization and liquidity additions; collects a fixed 1% swap fee split equally between a creator and platform fee receiver via afterSwapReturnsDelta; migrates all liquidity to a full-range AMM pool once the bonding curve supply is fully absorbed.
